description: Verify that DUT does NOT reassemble fragments whose Protocol fields differ — Protocol is part of the reassembly bucket key (RFC 791 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
A fragment claiming protocol X cannot be merged with a fragment claiming protocol Y — they belong to different upper-layer streams. RFC 791 includes Protocol in the bucket-key tuple.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: fragment 0 with protocol = ICMP (MF=1)
2. Tester → DUT: fragment 1 with protocol = some other (MF=0, same id, src, dst)
   ⇒ Different buckets — no reassembly.

3. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: no Echo Reply

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any Echo Reply within the window.

[Fail condition]
Same as IPV4_FRAGMENTS_02/03 — any Reply or wrong-field Reply indicates cross-protocol merging.

verdicts.Pass: DUT did not merge fragments across different protocols — normal
verdicts.Fail_early_reply: DUT replied — merged across different protocols
